description_en: Queries the details of multiple devices under a specified product
description_zh: 查询指定产品下多个设备的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-query-device-detail --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --iot-instance-id iot-v64000 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchQueryDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices specified by **DeviceName.N** belong
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>this parameter does not have a value, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device names to query. You can specify up to 100 device names.

> The devices to query must belong to the same product
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称列表。最多可包含100个设备名称。

> 查询的设备必须在同一产品下
parameters.name: device_name
